name: Zotero 文献库连接
description: Search, read (incl. PDF full text), add by DOI/PMID and export references in the user's local Zotero 7 library via the desktop app's local API. Read-only for existing items; never deletes.

inputs.name: doi_or_pmid
inputs.description: identifier for `add --doi` / `add --pmid`, or a JSON list via `add --json`

outputs: stdout JSON (search hits, item records, PDF text, add results)

requires.external: Zotero 7 desktop running with Settings → Advanced → 'Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero' enabled; internet only for add --doi/--pmid metadata lookup
